description: This file defines the InputPostprocCalibration class for recalibrating input devices in a Kivy application, including configuration parsing, provider mapping, and calibration processing methods.

classes.name: InputPostprocCalibration
classes.description: A class for recalibrating input devices by applying scale and offset transformations, with support for auto calibration based on display size.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the calibration object, loads device calibration settings from configuration, and builds a provider map.

methods.name: _get_provider_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping from MotionEvent subclasses to their provider names by inspecting registered input providers.

methods.name: _get_provider_key
methods.description: Returns the provider key for a given event if it is configured for calibration.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Applies calibration transformations to a list of input events based on device configuration.

methods.name: auto_calibrate
methods.description: Calculates calibrated sx, sy coordinates based on display size and window geometry.
